# `silk/build/plan`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pure package requirements built with the same standard actions and deferred paths as tasks.

A package declares `pub const PLAN: Plan` in `build.silk`. The compiler evaluates the value
without effects. Generated files and processes execute later through the build graph; package
processes require dependency authorization and a supported operating-system sandbox.

Import as `Plan` with `import silk.build.plan { Plan }`.

Public declarations: 4.

<a id="Library"></a>

## `Library`

```silk
pub struct Library
```

How a named library is linked: by static or dynamic search, and whether it is weak or retained.

### When to use

Pass it to `Plan.linkLibrary` or `Compilation.linkLibrary`. Start from [`Library.dynamicSearch`](#Library.impl.dynamicSearch) or
[`Library.staticSearch`](#Library.impl.staticSearch) and add [`Library.weak`](#Library.impl.weak) or [`Library.needed`](#Library.impl.needed) only where the link needs them.

<a id="Library.mode"></a>

### Field `mode`

```silk
pub mode: string<'static>
```

`"dynamic"` or `"static"`.

<a id="Library.isWeak"></a>

### Field `isWeak`

```silk
pub isWeak: bool
```

Whether the program may start when the library is absent.

<a id="Library.isNeeded"></a>

### Field `isNeeded`

```silk
pub isNeeded: bool
```

Whether the library stays linked when no symbol refers to it.

<a id="Plan.impl.linkDependency"></a>

### Method `linkDependency`

```silk
pub static fn linkDependency(self: Self, name: string<'static>) -> Self
```

Links the native plan of `name`, a dependency this package declares, into every artifact that
links this package, even when nothing imports it: for a package of only C, whose functions
this package declares itself. A name the manifest does not declare refuses the plan.
